segments.text: These are paracetamol, five hundred milligram tablets, for the pain.
Take two tablets when needed, up to four times a day, with or without food.
Leave at least four hours between doses, and do not take more than eight in a day.
Side effects are rare at the usual dose.
Do not drink alcohol heavily while taking these, and store them out of reach of children.
